zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.10** 改善空回复恢复、回复详情与消息交互，供继续评测。正式版仍为 0.0.18；全面验收、连续七天日用和正式版批准仍按原计划执行。

zh.title: 回复与详情
items: Responses 请求成功却没有可见回复或工具调用时，在同一模型和思考强度下进行一次有界恢复，保留上下文与已执行工具结果。连续空回复仍明确报错，不伪造成功；恢复请求照常计入使用量和原执行预算。
“查看详情”在悬停消息或键盘聚焦后出现在回复列最右侧，与回复状态保持间距；触屏保留直接入口。右侧详情按回复过程、关联任务和回复依据组织，步骤名称、路径、状态和耗时各有层级。
核验阶段使用宿主当前状态说明，避免旧报告中的“已完成”与“核验中”混用。过程卡片收起后不再残留大块空白。

zh.title: 消息与更新动画
items: 机器人回复跟随头像身份色，深浅主题采用柔和同色系底面；公开进展、最终回复和失败气泡保持一致。上传图片头像使用稳定的备用身份色。
点击回答选项立即显示待发送消息，回执后保留同一气泡；选项平滑收起，消息自然出现，焦点回到输入框。保留失败重试和重复点击保护，阅读历史时可以打断滚动跟随。
点击“更新”后，弹窗缩向左下角版本区，遮罩同时淡出，细进度条继续显示实际下载进度；下载完成出现“安装”。快速完成和下载失败有明确后续入口，减少动态效果时直接切换。
扩充深浅主题、窄窗口、身份配色、选项发送和更新过渡回归；同步中英文发布说明、用户指南和站点更新日志。

zh.title: 升级与回退
items: RC4–RC9 可在“设置 → 更新与关于”通过自动或 Beta 通道检查 RC10。旧 Beta5/RC1–RC3 请下载匹配架构的安装包手动升级。
退出旧宿主，备份完整数据根，Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 同步升级。npm 固定版本为 `@peer-agent/cli@0.1.0-rc.10`，`@rc` 跟随后续候选；归档中的 peer 与凭据助手须保持同目录。
需要回退时恢复升级前的完整备份，并另外保留新数据和产物；不要让旧版本直接写入新版本使用过的数据目录，无需为升级重置数据。

zh.title: 验证与已知限制
items: 源码产品截图与确定性交互由实施者自审，不是独立审查。受控模型与下载事件用于复现界面状态，不证明真实模型的回复质量、网络时序或实际下载速度。
空回复恢复不能补齐尚未投影的安全历史查询能力；原历史统计的证据缺口仍保留。本轮未新增能力、权限、IPC 或存储边界，不能据此声称原统计任务已完成。
发布流程核对三平台桌面产物、两平台 CLI、更新清单和 macOS 签名公证。Windows/Linux 交互安装、完整读屏、真实模型修复后验证、原生半透明观感及长期日用仍需对应验收。
部分真实服务超时、复杂写任务 Evidence 完整性及跨供应商复核独立性的覆盖缺口仍保留；总体 Ready 和 GA 未宣告通过。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.10** improves empty-response recovery, reply details and message interactions for continued evaluation. Stable remains 0.0.18; comprehensive acceptance, seven days of daily use and stable-release approval remain required.

en.title: Replies and details
items: When a successful Responses request returns no visible reply or tool calls, retry once with the same model and reasoning effort, preserving context and executed tool results. Repeated empty responses still report failure. Every recovery request counts toward usage and the existing execution budget.

Details appears at the right edge of the reply column on message hover or keyboard focus, separated from reply status. Touch devices retain a visible action. The sidebar groups process, related tasks and supporting records, with distinct step names, paths, states and durations.
Verification uses the host's current phase, preventing an older report's completed summary from contradicting a verifying state. Collapsed process cards no longer retain a large empty area.

en.title: Messages and update transitions
items: Bot replies follow their avatar identity color through soft surfaces in both themes. Public updates, final replies and failure bubbles share that identity. Image avatars use a stable fallback identity color.

Choosing an answer immediately shows its pending message and retains the same bubble after acknowledgement. Options collapse smoothly, new messages appear naturally and focus returns to the composer. Failure recovery and duplicate-click protection remain available; reading history can interrupt scroll following.

Update dialogs shrink toward the bottom-left version area as their backdrop fades. A thin progress bar displays actual download progress, followed by Install when ready. Fast completion and failed downloads retain clear actions; reduced motion switches directly.
Extend regression coverage for themes, narrow windows, identity colors, answer sending and update transitions. Refresh bilingual release notes, user guidance and the website changelog.

en.title: Upgrade and rollback
items: RC4–RC9 can check for RC10 through Auto or Beta in Settings → Update & About. Older Beta5/RC1–RC3 require a manual installer matching their architecture.

Quit older hosts, back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. Use `@peer-agent/cli@0.1.0-rc.10` for a fixed npm version; `@rc` follows later candidates. Keep peer and its credential helper together.

Roll back using the complete pre-upgrade backup while retaining new data and artifacts separately. Do not let an older version write directly to a data directory used by the new version. Upgrading does not require a reset.

en.title: Validation and known limits
items: Source screenshots and deterministic interactions are reviewed by the implementer, not an independent reviewer. Scripted cognition and download events reproduce interface states; they do not establish live model quality, network timing or actual download speed.

Empty-response recovery does not supply the missing governed history-query capability. Evidence gaps in the original history-statistics task remain. This release introduces no capability, permission, IPC or storage boundary and does not establish that task's completion.

Release checks cover desktop artifacts for three platforms, CLI archives for two platforms, update manifests and macOS signing and notarization. Interactive Windows/Linux installation, full screen-reader testing, post-fix live-model validation, native translucency and long-term use still require their corresponding acceptance.
Some service timeouts, complex-write Evidence completeness and verifier independence across providers remain coverage gaps. Overall readiness and GA are not declared complete.
